The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, January 12, 1935
9557
SHANGHAI POLICE
B. REGISTRY.

Gen. Macnaghten
In Motor Hold-Up

Two Bandits On Road
To Hangchow Take
$83 From Him

While motoring from Shanghai to Hangchow in his private car, Brigadier-General E. B. Macnaghten, member of the Shanghai Municipal Council, was held up by two bandits and robbed of $83 in cash at 11 o'clock yesterday morning, according to Chinese reports from Hangchow today.

It was learned that the veteran Council member, who during the critical period of 1932 was chairman of the city governing body, arrived in Hangchow safely and gave a detailed report to the authorities there.

Armed Men Block Road
The daring crime took place on the Haining-Haiyen border in the Chekiang section of the highway. Two bandits, armed with pistols, blocked the way and forced Brigadier-General Macnaghten to apply the brake. They boarded the car, searched his pockets, and relieved him of $83, according to the reports. When they completed the looting, one of the bandits fired a shot as a demonstration. The gun was fired into the air and no one was injured.

Description Of Bandits
According to Brig.-General Macnaghten's description, given the authorities, one of the bandits was aged about 20, wearing a gray long gown and a black "water-melon hat." He spoke in Kempo (Northern Kiangsu) dialect, it is said. The other was identified by a blue tint on his middle finger.

Bureau of Public Safety and Peace Preservation Corps officials, upon receipt of the report, immediately rushed squads to the scene of the daring crime and made investigations. They were continuing their investigations today although no trace of the gunmen could be found.

Near Sze Murder Scene
It was near Haining where Mr. Sze Liang-tsai, Shun Pao publisher, and two others met their tragic death on November 13. The party was returning to Shanghai by the motor-road when a gang of gunmen, said to be six in number, emptied their revolvers and automatics into the car, killing the chauffeur and a passenger, student of the Hangchow Christian College. When Mr. Sze fled, they gave chase and shot him dead at a close range.

Although a number of suspects had been rounded up, the investigations failed to bring any clues to the Chekiang authorities. Mr. Han Yen, chief of the Public Safety Bureau at Haining, was recently dismissed from his office for his failure to round up the criminals within the prescribed time-limit of 10 days after the crime.

（批：Reg. Please file and index under "Lawlessness near Shanghai" Noted. JHS）

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1935年1月12日，星期六
9557
上海警察
B. 登记处。

麦克纳格顿将军
遭遇汽车劫案

两名匪徒在前往
杭州的途中
抢走其83美元

据今日来自杭州的中文报道，上海公共租界工部局董事、准将E. B. 麦克纳格顿（E. B. Macnaghten）昨日中午11时驾驶私家车从上海前往杭州途中，遭遇两名匪徒拦截，并被抢走现金83美元。

据悉，这位资深董事（曾在1932年危急时期担任该市政机构主席）已安全抵达杭州，并向当地当局作了详细报告。

持枪者阻断道路
这起大胆的犯罪行为发生在浙江省境内公路的海宁-海盐交界处。据报道，两名手持手枪的匪徒阻断去路，迫使麦克纳格顿准将刹车。他们登上汽车，搜其身袋，抢走83美元。抢劫完毕后，其中一名匪徒开枪示警。子弹射向空中，无人受伤。

匪徒体貌特征
据麦克纳格顿准将向当局提供的描述，其中一名匪徒年约20岁，身穿灰色长衫，头戴黑色“西瓜帽”。据说其操肯波（江苏北部）方言。另一名匪徒的特征是中指呈蓝色。

公安局及保安队官员接到报告后，立即派遣小队赶赴这起大胆罪案的现场进行调查。尽管至今未发现枪手踪迹，但他们今日仍在继续调查。

靠近施姓谋杀案现场
案发地点靠近海宁，即11月13日《申报》发行人施良才（Sze Liang-tsai，音译）及另外两人惨遭杀害之地。当时该一行人正沿公路返回上海，一伙据称有六人的枪手向车内倾泻左轮手枪和自动手枪子弹，打死司机和一名乘客（杭州之江大学学生）。施先生逃跑时，匪徒追赶并在近距离将其枪杀。

尽管已抓获多名嫌疑人，但调查未能为浙江当局提供任何线索。海宁公安局长韩炎（Han Yen，音译）近期因未能在案发后规定的10天期限内抓获罪犯而被免职。

（批注：登记处。请归档并编入“上海附近不法行为”索引。已知悉。JHS）

January 12, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers:

ELECTRICITY SUPPLY TO WESTERN DISTRICT

With reference to the formation of a new power company in the Western District to supply electricity to the district, a draft agreement has been concluded. The Shanghai City Government has submitted the agreement to the Central Government for approval and the agreement will be signed after this has been obtained from Nanking.
It is reported that the draft agreement contains 43 Articles.
The new company will pay $1,500,000 for the business monopoly, and five per cent of its revenue will be paid to the Chinese Government in two instalments. The instalment for the first six months of the year will be paid at the end of August, while the instalment for the second half of the year will be made at the end of February in the following year. It is stipulated that the monopoly will expire in the 50th Year of the Republic of China (1961) with no extension and that the Shanghai City Government will buy over the property of the new company. The draft agreement also contains a stipulation that the new company should observe the orders of the Chinese Government and be supervised by the Government.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers (Hangchow telegram):

GENERAL MACNAGHTEN ROBBED OF $83 ON SHANGHAI-HANGCHOW HIGHWAY

At 11 a.m. January 11, General Macnaghten, Vice-Chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Council, left Shanghai in his private motor car (licence No. 6405) for Hangchow via the Shanghai-Hangchow highway.
When the car was passing Tseu Li Ye (普里埭) and Huang Wan (黄湾) between Hai Ning (海宁) and Hai Yen (海盐), two robbers armed with pistols ordered the car to stop. After relieving the occupant of a sum of $83, the robbers fired a few shots as a demonstration and made good their escape towards the hills in the south.
One of the robbers was dressed in a grey longgown and a Chinese hat. He is about 20 years of age and spoke the Kompo dialect. He had a middle finger which appeared to be shorter than the others.
Upon learning of the case, the Bureau of Public Safety at Hangchow immediately sent a party of armed policemen to the scene to make an investigation. Endeavours are being made to trace the robbers.

1935年1月12日。

1935年1月12日。晨间译文。

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸：

西区供电

关于在西区成立一家新电力公司以向该区供电事宜，已达成一项协议草案。上海市政府已将此协议提交中央政府批准，待从南京获得批准后，协议将正式签署。
据报道，该协议草案包含43条条款。
新公司将支付150万美元以获取业务垄断权，并将其收入的5%分两期支付给中国政府。上半年款项将于8月底支付，下半年款项将于次年2月底支付。规定垄断权将于中华民国50年（1961年）到期，不得延期，且上海市政府将收购新公司的财产。协议草案还规定，新公司应遵守中国政府的命令并接受政府监督。

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸（杭州电）：

麦克纳格顿将军在上海-杭州公路上被抢83美元

1月11日上午11时，上海公共租界工部局副主席麦克纳格顿将军驾驶私家车（牌照号6405）经上海-杭州公路离开上海前往杭州。
当车辆行驶至海宁与海盐之间的普里埭（Tseu Li Ye）和黄湾（Huang Wan）时，两名持手枪的劫匪命令停车。在抢走车内人员83美元后，劫匪开枪数发以示警告，随后向南面山区逃窜。
其中一名劫徒身穿灰色长衫，头戴中式帽子。年约20岁，操肯波（Kompo）方言。其中指看起来比其他手指短。
杭州公安局获悉此案后，立即派遣一队武装警察前往现场调查。目前正在努力追踪劫匪。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, DECEMBER 27, 1936
6412
U / 37

Foreigners On
Houseboat In
Pirate Attack

Launch With Five Boats
In Tow Raided On
Trip From Tahu

TWO POLICE OFFICERS
AND CIVILIAN

Banks Lined By Gang Armed
With Rifles; Robbed Of
Guns; Money Hidden

Two well-known members of the Shanghai Municipal Police, Detective Sub-Inspector C. A. Mason, of the Fingerprint Bureau, and Sub-Inspector H. G. Biggs, of Hongkew Station, were victims, together with Mr. R. J. Wallace, of a piratical attack during the holidays when returning in a "boat-train" from a shooting expedition in the Tahu Lake district.

They were in one of five houseboats being towed by the steam launch Li Shing and the convoy had reached a point about halfway between the Tahu Lake and Shanghai when a burst of rifle shots from the banks brought the launch to a halt, the houseboats being boarded soon afterwards by a score of men all armed with modern magazine rifles.

Messrs. Mason, Biggs and Wallace were robbed of six sporting guns and a quantity of ammunition but they concealed their money successfully. Other boats in the train lost amounts varying from $100 to $1,000.

While the raid was still in progress, another boat-train proceeding in the opposite direction was sighted in the creek, stopped by the pirates and similarly ransacked. The gang, about 25 in number, eventually made off in sailing junks.

Foreigner's Story

Relating the story of the affair, one of the foreign victims told a representative of "The Shanghai Sunday Times" that the attack took place at

about 12.45 a.m. on Christmas Eve in a deserted creek near Hsia Hu Teng.

The party were awakened by the firing of shots and the loadah rushed in to announce that robbers were attacking the boats. They picked up their sporting shot guns but, looking out of the window, saw that the bank was lined with armed men covering the boats with their rifles and realized that resistance, in the circumstances, would be futile.

Before the pirates boarded, however, they concealed their money—in the most obvious places, some in a cigarette case thrown under the bath, some on the surface of the bed concealed in the ruffled folds of the counterpane. The only monetary loss aboard was suffered by the Chinese servant, who was robbed of 70 cents, he, too, having concealed the notes in his possession.

Dangerous Moments

There were dangerous moments from ugly-looking and threatening desperadoes when no money was forthcoming and concealment was suspected, and one of the leaders, who uttered repeated menaces, demanded $3,000 as the price of their freedom.

The pirates took away six guns, including two .22 rifles, but left Detective-Inspector Mason's 16-bore which was overlooked in its case, and later abandoned on another boat a 12-bore belonging to Sub-Inspector Biggs.

Search made was far from thorough, the arrival of a second victim for attack possibly contributing to its hurried nature. The party witnessed the raid on this boat-train, but could see very little in the darkness.

The Li Shing, with her boats in tow, was permitted to proceed at 2 a.m. and the incident was reported at the next village.

（批：28/12）
（印：M B 28 DEC. 1936 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

《上海星期时报》，1936年12月27日
6412
U / 37

外国人在
海盗袭击中
遇险

拖带五艘船的汽艇
在从太湖返回途中
遭劫

两名警官
及一名平民

河岸布满持步枪匪帮；
枪支被抢；钱财藏匿

上海公共租界警务处两名知名成员，指纹局的侦探副督察C. A. 梅森（C. A. Mason）和虹口巡捕房的副督察H. G. 比格斯（H. G. Biggs），与R. J. 华莱士（R. J. Wallace）先生一起，在假期从太湖地区狩猎归来乘坐“船队”时，成为海盗袭击的受害者。

他们所在的五艘画舫之一由“利生”号（Li Shing）蒸汽汽艇拖带，当船队行驶至太湖与上海之间约一半路程时，岸边传来一阵步枪射击声，迫使汽艇停航，随后约二十名全部装备现代弹仓式步枪的男子登上了画舫。

梅森、比格斯和华莱士三位先生被抢走六支运动用枪和大量弹药，但他们成功藏匿了钱财。船队中的其他船只损失金额从100美元到1,000美元不等。

在抢劫仍在进行时，另一支沿河道相反方向行驶的船队被海盗发现并拦停，同样遭到洗劫。这伙约25人的匪帮最终乘坐帆船逃离。

外国人的叙述

一位外国受害者在向《上海星期时报》代表讲述事件经过时表示，袭击发生在

12月24日凌晨约12点45分，地点在下湖荡（Hsia Hu Teng，音译）附近的一条荒凉河道中。

众人被枪声惊醒，船老大冲进来宣布有强盗袭击船只。他们拿起运动用猎枪，但向窗外望去，发现河岸上站满了持枪男子，用步枪瞄准船只，意识到在这种情况下抵抗是徒劳的。

然而，在海盗登船之前，他们将钱财藏在最显眼的地方——有的藏在扔在浴缸下的烟盒里，有的藏在床上，掩蔽在床罩皱褶的表面。船上唯一的金钱损失是一名中国仆人遭受的，他被抢走70美分，他也曾试图藏匿手中的钞票。

危险时刻

当拿不出钱且怀疑有人藏匿时，那些面目狰狞、充满威胁的亡命之徒制造了危险时刻。其中一名头目反复发出威胁，索要3,000美元作为释放他们的代价。

海盗带走了六支枪，包括两支.22口径步枪，但漏掉了装在枪套里的梅森侦探督察的16号口径猎枪，后来又在另一艘船上遗弃了属于比格斯副督察的一支12号口径猎枪。

搜查远非彻底，第二支受害船队的到来可能导致了搜查的匆忙。当事人目睹了对那支船队的抢劫，但在黑暗中几乎看不清什么。

凌晨2时，“利生”号及其拖带的船只获准继续航行，事件在下一个村庄得到报告。

（批注：12/28）
（印章：M B 1936年12月28日 上海公共租界警务处）

January 16, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated January 15:

THE ROBBERY OF A FOREIGN RESIDENT ON THE SHANGHAI-HANGCHOW
HIGHWAY - TRUTH OF REPORT UNKNOWN

A few days ago, a telegram reported that
General Macnaghter, Vice-Chairman of the S.M.C., was held
up and robbed of a sum of money at a place between Hai
Ning (海寧) and Hai Yen (海鹽) on the Shanghai-Hangchow
highway. As the case has attracted International
attention, our reporter visited the scene of the robbery
and made enquiries of the Chinese Authorities. The
following information was given to our reporter:-
On January 11, General Macnaghten, Vice-
Chairman of the S.M.C. and Chairman of the Board of
Directors of the British American Tobacco Company,
accompanied by Sung Kwen San (宋光生), a representative
of the B.A.T. Company, left Shanghai in his motor car
bearing Shanghai City Government licence No. 6405 for
Hangchow to call on General Huang Shao Yung, Chairman
of the Chekiang Provincial Government, to discuss certain
matters with him. At about noon, as the car was
travelling between Cho Li Ye (諸里葉) and Huang Wan (黃灣),
they heard reports of gunfire. The motor car returned
to the Cho Li Ye Station and Tseu Teng Sze (周登司),
Chief of the Station, was requested to detail a police
escort. Subsequently, Sung Kwen San said that they
met two robbers who had deprived them of over $100
in notes.
Upon receipt of the report, the Chief of the
Cho Li Ye Station notified the other stations in the
neighbourhood and the Police organs along the highway
to keep a watch for the robbers. He also questioned
Huang Wan Station, but the latter replied that no robbery
had taken place.
At this stage, Zee Yen (茲炎), Commissioner
of the Bureau of Public Safety at Hai Ning, accompanied
by a party of staff members and policemen, left Hai Ning
in a motor car for the scene of the robbery. He met
General Macnaghten's motor car (licence No. 6405)
in the vicinity of Ting Chong (亭橋). They then went
together to Hai Ning Station.
At the station, Sung Kwen San said:- "General
Macnaghten has been robbed of $40 in notes, the chauffeur
of $13 in notes, while I was robbed of about $30 in notes.
I cannot remember how many dollars I lost. The robbers
were dressed like countrymen and wore Chinese hats.
They fired a shot as a demonstration."
The Commissioner of the Hai Ning Public Safety
Bureau immediately sent out a number of policemen and
detectives to trace the robbers.
Detective Ma Zoe Fang arrived at Hai Ning Hsien
and telephoned to the Magistrate of Hai Yen Hsien and
was informed that a revenue guard had opened fire in
connection with a smuggling case and that enquiries were
in progress.
Becoming suspicious of the affair, detective
Ma Zoe Fang, in company with a party of officers and men
of the Hai Ning Public Safety Bureau, visited the scene
of the alleged robbery. Enquiries at the stations and

1月15日《大美晚报》：

上海-杭州公路上外籍居民遭劫案 - 报道真实性不明

日前有电报称，
上海公共租界工部局副主席麦克纳格顿将军（General Macnaghter）在上海-杭州公路上海宁（Hai Ning）与海盐（Hai Yen）之间某地被拦截并抢走一笔钱款。由于此案引起国际关注，本报记者走访了抢劫现场并向中国当局进行了查询。以下信息为当局向记者提供：-
1月11日，上海公共租界工部局副主席兼英美烟草公司董事会主席麦克纳格顿将军，在英美烟草公司代表宋光生（Sung Kwen San，音译）陪同下，驾驶悬挂上海市政府牌照第6405号的汽车离开上海前往杭州，拜访浙江省政府主席黄绍竑将军，与其商讨某些事项。中午时分，当汽车行驶在诸里叶（Cho Li Ye，音译）与黄湾（Huang Wan）之间时，他们听到枪声。汽车返回诸里叶车站，请求站长周登司（Tseu Teng Sze，音译）派遣警察护送。随后，宋光生称他们遇到两名劫匪，被抢走纸币100余元。
诸里叶站长接到报告后，通知附近各车站及公路沿线警察机关留意劫匪动向。他还询问了黄湾车站，但后者回复称未发生抢劫案。
在此阶段，海宁公安局局长兹炎（Zee Yen，音译）带领一批职员和警察，驾车从海宁出发前往抢劫现场。他在亭桥（Ting Chong，音译）附近遇到了麦克纳格顿将军的汽车（牌照号6405）。随后他们一同前往海宁车站。
在车站，宋光生称：“麦克纳格顿将军被抢走纸币40元，司机被抢走纸币13元，而我被抢走纸币约30元。我不记得具体损失了多少美元。劫徒装扮如乡下人，头戴中式帽子。他们开枪示警。”
海宁公安局局长立即派出多名警察和侦探追踪劫匪。
侦探马佐芳（Ma Zoe Fang，音译）抵达海宁县，致电海盐县知事，得知有一名缉私警卫因走私案开枪，目前正在进行调查。
马佐芳侦探对此事产生怀疑，会同海宁公安局的一批警员前往所谓抢劫现场。在各车站进行的查询以及

China Times and other local newspapers:

WORLD NEWS AGENCY ILLEGALLY TAKES FILMS IN CHINA

（批：Film）
New York newspapermen are paying special
attention to the murder of John C. Stan and his wife by
Red bandits in Anhwei.
George F. Krainuhs, Chief of the World News
Agency, is coming to China to make an investigation.
He intends to use the baby and the statements of the
officers sent by the American Authorities for a film
version of the murder to be sent to foreign countries
for screening.
As this constitutes a violation of the Rules
for the taking of pictures by foreigners in China, the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs has requested the Ministry
of Finance to instruct the Chinese Maritime Customs to
detain the films, while the Ministry of Communications
will order the Chinese Post Office to detain them also.

Shanghai Morning Post:

LECTURE ON THE INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT

The fourth lecture on international subjects being
delivered under the auspices of the Shanghai Municipality
Educational Association will be broadcasted at 2 p.m.
to-day by Kwei Sze Hsiung (世勳). The subject will

1935年1月16日。下午译件。

据向附近农民了解，并未发生抢劫案，而是一名缉私卫兵因一起走私案件开了枪。曹家渡巡捕房主管周鹏思（Tseu Peng Sze，音译）作了类似报告，并补充说，麦克纳格滕将军（General Macnaghten）所乘汽车确因听到枪声报告而返回，并请求保护。周鹏思接着表示，他未听闻任何关于抢劫的消息。

侦探马佐芳（Ma Zoe Fang，音译）走访了海盐县，得知该县境内并未发生抢劫案。相关各县及警方正在对此案进行调查。已请兼任浙江省政府民政厅厅长的黄绍竑将军进行严密调查。

根据从其他渠道获得的消息，自《申报》前总经理史量才遇刺身亡以来，沪杭公路沿线的警务力量已得到加强。

麦克纳格滕将军与B....T.公司的宋文三（Sung Kwen San，音译）在完成杭州的任务后，于1月13日下午乘汽车返回上海。麦克纳格滕将军不愿就此事发表任何声明。

据上海某外文报纸收到的消息，有关发生抢劫的报道不实。

《中国时报》及其他本地报纸：

世界新闻社在华非法拍摄影片

（批注：影片）

纽约报界正特别关注约翰·C·斯坦（John C. Stan）及其妻子在安徽被“赤匪”杀害一案。

世界新闻社社长乔治·F·克雷努斯（George F. Krainuhs，音译）即将来华进行调查。他打算利用那名婴儿以及美国当局派遣官员的陈述，制作一部关于该谋杀案的电影版本，并送往国外放映。

由于此举违反了外国人在华摄影规则，外交部已请求财政部指令中国海关扣留这些胶片，同时交通部也将命令中国邮政局予以扣留。

《上海晨报》：

关于国际租界的讲座

由上海市教育协会主办的一系列国际问题讲座中的第四讲，将于今日下午2时由桂世勋（Kwei Sze Hsiung）通过广播播出。讲座主题为“什么是上海国际租界”。讲座将从安定广播电台播送。
